scientific_question: Can a fixed target-free detector-coordinate canonicalization derived only from the deployment-visible exact-K1 residual and reported geometry close the remaining p33s01 five-camera cross-trajectory support gap without harming any train stratum that already passed v152?

feature_contract.detector_summary: signed 2x2 DCT-II block plus relative log RMS for observation, exact-K1 residual, and exact-K1 detector dual
feature_contract.pose_standardization: unchanged frozen v129 centre and scale after coordinate mapping

shared_mass_contract.normalization: divide by per-camera total residual magnitude
shared_mass_contract.reason: the fixed uniform mixture makes both separable marginals strictly positive and bounds transport distortion without fit or heldout tuning

cheap_control.axis_map: weighted residual-magnitude centroid and standard deviation mapped to the fixed 16-point detector grid

primary_candidate.axis_map: unique separable inverse CDF at the 16 fixed midpoint quantiles
primary_candidate.interpolation: bilinear on the fixed normalized detector grid
primary_candidate.amplitude_jacobian: none; detector components remain in their reported physical displacement units
primary_candidate.state_consistency: the identical inverse-v and inverse-u map is applied to observation, exact-K1 residual, and exact-K1 detector dual

reported_geometry_consistency.offset_rule: map each normalized offset relative to the mapped zero coordinate; use the geometric mean local inverse scale for the scalar detector half width

support_audit.split: complete-trajectory leave-one-trajectory-out over all six train trajectories
support_audit.normalization: sample-equal weighted mean and scale fit only on the five non-heldout trajectories
support_audit.reference_selection: deterministic midpoint rows within each trajectory and camera-count stratum
support_audit.support_threshold: higher-method 90th percentile of cross-trajectory nearest-neighbour RMS distances among fit-only reference rows
support_audit.query_neighbours: all active rows from the five non-heldout trajectories with identical camera count

non_exchangeable_decision_rule: The affine-moment control is diagnostic and cannot rescue the primary decision.
The monotone primary passes only if p33s01 and p33s03 each reach at least 0.90 support in every 5/7/9/12-camera stratum.
Every trajectory-camera stratum that passed the frozen raw-camera45 v152 audit must remain at or above 0.90 under the monotone primary.
Any invalid map, incomplete 36630-row audit, source/input drift, reserved-data access, or independent discrepancy makes the run inconclusive rather than successful.
If the primary fails, the current cross-trajectory coefficient-predictor route stops until broader train data are available; no larger CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet, or GPU run may be used to rescue it.

If the primary passes and independent validation agrees, the result authorizes only a separately frozen minimal observation/geometry-only predictor protocol, not predictor performance or algorithm success.

requirements: independently rebuild both coordinate maps and bilinear state transforms
independently rebuild six LOTO folds, thresholds, nearest neighbours, summaries, and primary decision
verify camera permutation equivariance and parent/formal trees unchanged
compare all sealed formal arrays only after independent outputs are written
